title: Search, filter and sort a list
when: The user has a list or table (products, contacts, tasks) and wants a search box, filter controls and sortable columns.
prompt:
Goal: Instant, combinable search, filters and sorting over in memory data, with state in the URL and results announced.
Steps:
1. One state { q, filters, sort: { key, dir } }; derive the visible list with a pure view(items, state).
2. Search: lowercase, NFD and strip marks (/\p{Diacritic}/gu) on both sides; every query word must match a precomputed search text per item.
3. Filters: labeled selects or checkboxes, AND across groups and OR within one, with counts per option.
4. Sort: comparator per key (Intl.Collator for text, timestamps for dates) with an id tie breaker; the header button sets aria-sort on its th.
5. Debounce input 150 ms; render with textContent; "12 of 240 results" in a role="status" region, plus a Clear filters button.
6. Sync state to the URL with URLSearchParams and history.replaceState, and restore it on load.
Quality bar:
- No typing lag on 5 thousand items.
- Accents and case never affect matching.
- Sort state is visible in the header.
Pitfalls:
- Filtering the source array in place.
- Rebuilding search text on every keystroke.
- Sort buttons with no state for screen readers.
Verify:
- [ ] view() is pure and tested.
- [ ] aria-sort on the sorted column.
- [ ] Result count in a status region.
- [ ] The URL reflects the state.
Output: js/list-view.js with state, view and render, plus search, filter and table markup.

examples.input: busca e filtro por categoria na lista de produtos
examples.output: search box ignoring accents, category checkboxes with counts, sortable price column, "8 of 64" status
